messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] branch naming
parts:
I second this naming convention.

Quick question: should we always create an issue before creating a working branch? I don't think it's that much trouble to do so.


On Fri, May 16, 2014 at 11:12 AM, Bob Carpenter <ca...@alias-i.com> wrote:
Unless someone has a better idea, I think we should stick to
the following naming conventions for branches:

  feature/issue-<NUMBER>-<description>
  hotfix/ ...

where <NUMBER> is the issue number in the issue tracker and <description>
is a very short description.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] branch naming
parts:
On May 17, 2014, at 2:49 AM, Daniel Lee <bea...@alum.mit.edu> wrote:

> I second this naming convention.
>
> Quick question: should we always create an issue before creating a working branch? I don't think it's that much trouble to do so.

I think so. It gives us a place to make notes about the intention
of the branch in a way that's easily searchable from GitHub.

- Bob
